description: This file defines an abstract class 'TopologyMapper' and its implementations for providing topology information of hosts in a Spark environment, including a default mapper and a file-based mapper.

classes.name: TopologyMapper
classes.description: An abstract class providing topology information for a given host, to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: DefaultTopologyMapper
classes.description: A TopologyMapper implementation assuming all nodes are in the same rack, with minimal topology info.

classes.name: FileBasedTopologyMapper
classes.description: A TopologyMapper implementation that reads topology info from a properties file specified in SparkConf.

methods.name: getTopologyForHost
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve topology info for a hostname.

methods.name: getTopologyForHost
methods.description: Returns None, assuming all nodes are in the same rack.

methods.name: getTopologyForHost
methods.description: Retrieves topology info from a properties file for a given hostname, with logging.
